description: Client-side routing for multi-page React apps via react-router-dom — pages, nested layouts, URL params, programmatic navigation. For any product that has more than a single view and lives in a non-framework (Vite) React setup. Next.js / Remix / SvelteKit have their own file-based routers and don't need this.

buildHints.whenToUse: Attach on react-vite-ts (or any non-framework React host) when the product has multiple pages — proposal list + detail, dashboard + settings, any /foo + /foo/:id pattern. Skip on Next.js / Remix / SvelteKit / Astro (they have file-based routers).
firstSteps: Use <Link>/<NavLink> for navigation — never <a href> for internal routes
useParams() in child routes for URL-driven state
gotchas: react-router-dom v7 merged with remix-run/react-router — APIs are stable but import paths shifted slightly from v6.
SSR + v7 needs explicit data loaders; client-only apps (Vite SPA) stay with createBrowserRouter.
